drawnTopologyRecords.claim: RM413 IN02 has a double-boot branch to RM417, referring to CB16OP038A-02006-DR-EL-0044. The RM417 drawing reciprocally says FROM RM413 (RMU), through SS417-RM417-P01 to RM417-SW01.

SS417-RM417 has one 22000 V, 630 A bar. Incoming SW01 and separate SW02 each show main/earth contact arrangements. SW02's upper conductor has no named outgoing destination on WH-S01; it is not evidence of an enabled second source.

RM417 CB01 and SW03 switching/earth assembly feed two separate transformer primaries: SS417-TF417 (2500 kVA, 22/6.9 kV, DYN11) and SS417-TF417A (500 kVA, 22/0.415 kV, DYN11). They share the depicted outgoing feeder; do not invent one breaker per transformer.

drawnTopologyRecords.claim: MC417 has an HV phase bar labelled 6.6 kV, 200 A. Incoming tier1 contains a 200 A VCB and a transformer-side earth branch. Tier2/3 and tier4/5 each have paired fused contactor paths meeting at a sizer motor-side conductor, plus a motor-side maintenance earth branch. Auxiliary 24/48 V lines are not that HV bar.

RM417 CB02 / SW04 feeds the depicted SS416-HV416 branching point in HOPPER 3 SS416 KIOSK, then distinct SS416-TF416 (2500 kVA, 22/6.9 kV, DYN11) and SS416-TF416A (500 kVA, 22/0.415 kV, DYN11). Their destinations are SS416-MC416 HV and SS416-MC416A LV respectively.

Hopper9 RM419-SW01 supply is explicitly RM410-CB03 at the CV006 tail. RM410 detail shows the CB03-A04 / SW04 outgoing assembly continuing to RM419-SW01. Both ends must be preserved; the cable alone does not bypass those devices.

drawnTopologyRecords.claim: RM419 has one 22 kV bar, incoming SW01 and through SW02. SW02's conductor is explicitly SUPPLY TO HP007 RMU (RM418-SW01), with exact reference CB17OP023C-01006-DR-EL-0001. The receiving page explicitly says SUPPLY FROM SR419-RM419 (RM419-SW02), reference CB19OP001C-01068-DR-EL-0001.

RM419 CB01 / SW03 feeds SS419-TF419A (2500 kVA, 22/6.9 kV, DYN11); CB02 / SW04 independently feeds SS419-TF419B (1500 kVA, 22/0.415 kV, DYN11). The former supplies SR419-MC419 HV, the latter SR419-MC419A LV. SR419 and SS419 prefixes both occur; retain printed aliases.

MC419's HV phase bar is labelled 6.6 kV, 200 A. Its incoming VCB/earth assembly is tier5, and the two paired fused motor-contactor groups occupy tiers1/2 and3/4. Motor-side earth branches are shown. Do not copy MC417/418 tier numbering onto MC419.

SS418-RM418 is a separate 22 kV, 630 A bar. SW01 receives RM419-SW02; SW02 is explicitly SPARE. Current detailed revision6 shows outgoing CB03 and CB04. CB03's main/earth contact assembly feeds both SS418-TF418 (2500 kVA, 22/6.9 kV, DYN11) and SS418-TF418A (500 kVA, 22/0.415 kV, DYN11); CB04's outgoing side is SPARE.

TF418 feeds SS418-MC418 HV; TF418A feeds SS418-MC418A LV. MC418's incoming 200 A VCB/earth assembly is tier1. Its HV bar is labelled 6.6 kV; tiers2/3 and4/5 carry paired fused motor contactors and motor-side earth branches.

Hopper8 is explicitly a separate source path from RM406-CB03 to SS416-HV416 via SS416-HV416-P01, then TF416 / TF416A in HOPPER 8 SS416 KIOSK. It is not drawn connected to RM418's local HV bar. RM406's CB03/SW04 route is reciprocally headed Hopper008.

interlockEvidence.explicitEvidence: Note5 identifies a sizer-maintenance Ronis key interlock and says the key is captive with the earth switch OFF. Note6 identifies a 6.9 kV HV key interlock: the earth switch can close after the upstream earth switch is closed, and its key is captive when ON.
interlockEvidence.unconfirmed: Installed key identities, ownership, all permitted transitions and exact upstream-device mapping. Do not infer a complete rule set or invent a transferable key token from these sentences.

interlockEvidence.explicitEvidence: Same explicit Ronis maintenance-key and upstream-earth/key-captive wording as WH-I01. Note11 separately says 100 A fuses are to be replaced with 200 A in future.
interlockEvidence.unconfirmed: Actual fuse upgrade/commissioning; full installed interlock configuration and key exchange. The future note is not an accepted current rating/state.

interlockEvidence.explicitEvidence: RM419 earth switch is to have **administrative controls** and is to be closed before the downstream earth switch is closed; note refers to CB19OP001C-01068-DR-EL-0002.
interlockEvidence.unconfirmed: This explicitly describes administrative controls. It does not establish that a physical device prevents a conflicting action or define an executable physical key system. The exact affected RM419 earth switch is not uniquely identified by the general note alone.

interlockEvidence.explicitEvidence: Note5 identifies Ronis maintenance key and key captive when earth OFF. Note6 says the 6.9 kV HV earth switch can close after the upstream earth switch is closed; its printed reference is CB19OP001C-01068-DR-EL-0002 (the same sheet).
interlockEvidence.unconfirmed: Unlike WH-S03/S05 note6, this note does not state the additional captive-when-ON sentence. The relationship between this note and WH-I03's administrative provision needs confirmation; do not copy the missing sentence into this source or treat an upstream administrative action as a confirmed physical block.

interlockEvidence.sourceClause: WH-S03 rev3, WH-S05 rev2, WH-S10 rev2 p1 legends F and assemblies C-D
interlockEvidence.explicitEvidence: Legends explicitly identify electrical, mechanical and key interlock glyphs. Paired motor contactors have drawn linkage; incoming VCB/earth arrangements have drawn linkages and note callouts. Note8 says a door-mounted padlockable switch is lockable only OFF.
interlockEvidence.unconfirmed: Complete switch-position truth tables, contactor/earth dependencies, removable/trucked equipment conditions and the identity of every lockable asset. **Inference:** linked paired motor contactors are candidate mutually exclusive paths; owner/source confirmation is needed before encoding that predicate as installed behaviour.

reviewQuestions.question: WH-S15 labels RM418 outgoing CB01-A03 / CB02-A04 and transformers TF418A (6.9 kV) / TF418B (415 V). WH-S04 rev6 and WH-S19 show CB03 / CB04 and TF418 (6.9 kV) / TF418A (415 V), with CB04 spare.

reviewQuestions.question: WH-S08's control page uses RM418-CB01 with SW03 status while WH-S04 rev6 identifies CB03. Its 24 V source reference prints CB16OP038A-02006-DR-EL-0081 despite the CB17OP023C page identity.

reviewQuestions.question: WH-S16 points Hopper008 to CB17OP023C-04057-DR-EL-0001; the supplied hopper RMU filename is CB17OP023C-01006-DR-EL-0001. WH-S04 reciprocally names RM406-CB03 and its supplied -04057-0002 source.

reviewQuestions.question: Both overviews' notes1-2 state high-level reference use and direct isolation work to detailed SLDs, HV switching programs and key-interlocking procedures. WH-S07 has later construction revision3 after older AS BUILT revision1.
